items.source: Strategic autonomy depends on industrial competitiveness, and two recent findings show industrial competitiveness is under strain. Each link is sourced; the chain as a whole is the Radar's inference.

items.source: Sources show a gap in AI governance. Joint public purchasing of AI compute already exists. No source has yet suggested using one for the other. A buyer this large can set conditions for access. That is a way to improve AI governance without a new law. Evidence: two studies and the EU, since July. No source makes this connection yet; it is the Radar's inference.
